mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within two months signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three months indicates a robust demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month indicates strong job growth, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with high borrowing costs, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary period with high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals strong economic growth coupled with a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% quarter-over-quarter and UNRATE decreases > 0.3% in the same period
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
